name: Nazmus Shams
bio:
I run a handful of small companies out of Dhaka — a salon, a
stationery studio, a wedding business, a restaurant — and throw
parties on the side because I can't quite help myself. This is a
walkthrough of what nine years of saying yes has turned into.

name: Afsana Rahman
bio: Afsana Rahman is a Dhaka-based entrepreneur, wedding planner, and who leads the whole event management studio Wedding Berries.
